desc:
🟢 Slime ragdoll physics! Break physics. Have fun!
SLIME PHYSICS is a playground where YOU are the slime. Roll, stretch, squish and launch yourself around a world full of silly toys!
💥 Blast yourself out of a CANNON. Aim it anywhere and follow the path to your landing spot!
🏹 Pull back the SLINGSHOT and fling yourself sky high!
🥊 Hit the button and get PUNCHED by the giant boxing glove!
🌀 Hop in a PIPE and pop out of the matching one!
🌬️ Float up on a FAN or bounce on the TRAMPOLINE!
🧱 Squeeze through tiny gaps and survive the crushing walls!
Every toy does something different, and every landing is a surprise. Try them all, mix them up, and see how far you can fly!
🛍️ Collect skins, trails and toys in the shop to make your slime your own.
👍 Like and ⭐ favorite to support us — more toys are coming soon!
